posts.text: Russian ballistic missile strikes hit three major bridges across Kyiv’s Dnipro River on Friday, killing three people and injuring 15, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said. The attacks forced bridge closures and traffic restrictions, damaged critical infrastructure and sparked fires. The strikes followed Putin’s warning of retaliation after Ukraine attacked the Crimean Bridge for a third time this week. Apartment buildings in Dnipropetrovsk, a hospital in Kharkiv and a tram in Zaporizhzhia were also struck, local officials said.

🌿 Good Morning & Jumaa Mubarakah 🌿 🌻 On this blessed Friday, let us pause and reflect upon a warning that touches the very heart of faith. ✨ Sheikh Hussain Korani (ra) said: “Harming a believer is among the greatest causes of faith being taken away. Any harm caused by a person who wishes to stand in prayer with humility and fulfil his duty will remain present with him in the very heart of his prayer—perhaps even becoming what turns his heart away from attentiveness and humility.” 💫 Reflect on the gravity of the expression “the taking away of faith” is frightening. ❎ It does not merely speak of losing some rewards or missing a few good deeds. ✅ It warns that a person’s oppression and harm toward others may reach a point where the light of faith itself is stripped from the heart. ⁉️ How easily, then, can we underestimate the wounds we cause? 🔎 A believer may be hurt by: ➖ humiliation, ➖ mockery, ➖ exposing private matters, ➖ spreading entrusted words, ➖ insulting or defaming someone, ➖ deliberately breaking their heart, ➖ manipulating their feelings, ➖ causing unjust sorrow, ➖ making false promises, ➖ withholding their rightful money, ➖ delaying what is owed, ➖ denying their rights, ➖ backbiting, ➖ slandering, ➖ betraying a trust, ➖ reminding them of their faults, ➖ or turning people against one another... ⚠️ Sometimes a wound leaves no mark on the body—but its pain remains in the heart. 🔴 And perhaps the person we hurt goes to prayer carrying the weight of what we did, while we stand before Allah unaware of the consequence. 💪 So on this Friday, let us make a sincere intention: not to be a source of pain for another believer. ✊ Let us guard our tongues, honour trusts, return rights, conceal faults, forgive, and repair what we have broken. 🤲 May Allah purify our hearts from oppression, protect our faith from being taken away, and make us among those whose presence brings peace rather than pain. 🤲 O Allah, forgive us for every heart we have wounded, every trust we have betrayed, every right we have withheld, and every word through which we caused harm. 🌹 May your Friday be filled with mercy, forgiveness, light, and steadfast faith.

ပဲခူးနဲ့မွန်နယ်စပ်က တပ်စခန်း ၂၈ ခုသိမ်းဆည်းထားကြောင်း စစ်တပ်ထုတ်ပြန်မှု မမှန်နိုင်ဟုဆို ပဲခူး၊ နိုဝင်ဘာ ၂၀၊ ၂၀၂၆။ ပဲခူးတိုင်း၊ ရွှေကျင်မြို့နယ်နဲ့ မွန်ပြည်နယ်၊ ကျိုက်ထိုမြို့နယ်အစပ်က ပဲခူးခရိုင်ပြည်သူ့ကာကွယ်ရေးစခန်းအပါအဝင် တပ်စခန်း ၂၈ ခုသိမ်းဆည်းထားနိုင်တယ်လို့ နိုဝင်ဘာလ ၂၀ ရက်နေ့က အာဏာသိမ်းစစ်တပ်က ထုတ်ပြန်လိုက်ပါတယ်။ ထုတ်ပြန်ချက်အရ နိုဝင်ဘာလ ၃ ရက်နေ့ကနေ ၁၉ ရက်နေ့အတွင်းမှာ တပ်စခန်း ၂၈ ခုအထိ သိမ်းယူထားနိုင်ပြီး ပဲခူးတိုင်း၊ ရွှေကျင်မြို့နယ်ထဲက ၁၁ ခုနဲ့ မွန်ပြည်နယ်၊ ကျိုက်ထိုမြို့နယ်ထဲက စခန်း ၁၇ ခုပါဝင်တယ်လို့ ဆိုပါတယ်။ သိမ်းခံရတဲ့ စခန်းတွေထဲမှာ NUG အထူးတိုင်းစခန်း၊ KNLA တပ်ရင်း ၃ စစ်ကြောင်းရုံး၊ ဗျူဟာ ၂၇ ဗျူဟာရုံး၊ ပဲခူးခရိုင်ပြည်သူ့ကာကွယ်ရေးစခန်း၊ နဂါးဖြူတပ်ရင်းစခန်းအပါအဝင် ယာယီစခန်းငယ်တွေလည်းပါဝင်တယ်လို့ ထုတ်ပြန်ချက်မှာ ဖော်ပြထားပါတယ်။ သတင်းအပြည့်အစုံ - https://myaelattathan.com/news/26963/
